title: Fulfill orders through ports
summary: Fulfill an order through repository and notifier ports while wrapping every failure so callers can inspect it with errors.Is.
objectives: Wrap repository, validation, and delivery failures so callers can inspect them with errors.Is.
Depend on the Repository and Notifier interfaces instead of concrete implementations.
Enforce validation precedence before any notification side effect.
constraints: Keep the public Order, Repository, Notifier, Result, sentinel errors, and Fulfill signature unchanged.
Wrap every failure with fmt.Errorf and %w so errors.Is still matches the documented sentinel.
Evaluate load, recipient, minimum total, and send in that order.
Send exactly one confirmation only when the order qualifies.
Use the message format Order {id} confirmed: {total} cents.

examples.output: Result{Sent: true, Message: "Order A-100 confirmed: 2500 cents"}, nil
examples.explanation: A qualifying order sends exactly one confirmation.
The recipient check runs before the minimum-total check, so the invalid recipient wins.

examples.input: Notifier returns an error wrapping a transport failure
examples.output: Result{}, error "send confirmation for A-100: ..." that still matches the transport sentinel with errors.Is
examples.explanation: The delivery failure is wrapped, not replaced.
